sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-MP22 key (RB-MP22 key) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base Service and Repair Center workshop rooms.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Second floor of the Western Repair Point Building marked with a white knight on Reserve. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Two Weapon racks (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
- 1-3 Wooden Ammo Box
- 1-3 Toolbox
- Possible 6-STEN-140-M military battery
- Loose loot (Tools, Weapon mods)
